title: [Additional wealth-tax]
text:
18D. [Additional wealth-tax].—Omitted by the Direct Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 1989 (3 of 1989),

_s. 95 (w.e.f. 1-4-1989. Earlier it was inserted by the Direct Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 1987 (4 of 1988),_
_s. 143 (w.e.f. 1-4-1989)._
